regime.summary: Policy rate 12.25% after a 250bp hike on 2022-04-07, the 6M T-bill sits 1.60pp above it so the market prices more hikes, CPI is rising, the rupee is down 6.1% in three months and Brent is 105. Past hike cycles with a rupee squeeze fell hard. The index bounced 4.7% in a month, which is not a regime change. Stay out until the rate and rupee turn.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 12.25%; last MPC decision 2022-04-07: hike (+250bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +1.60pp (market pricing hikes)
Lesson: read the rate and the rupee, not the politics.

watch.subject: Next SBP MPC decision
watch.trigger: Act on the rate or rupee turning (T-bill spread to policy rate closing, CPI falling) once the MPC date is known; until then no index-level risk.

evidence.quote: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +1.60pp (market pricing hikes)

watch.subject: EFERT results-day reaction (first quarter results)
watch.trigger: Gap-up on results day with a close above 96.04 would be a results-gap-up watch; the base rate is only a watch, not tradable.

watch.subject: GGL
watch.trigger: Three upper locks in 10 days with volume ignition; the method calls this nothing or watch-not-tradable, so only watch for the lock streak to end and price to hold.

watch.subject: NETSOL
watch.trigger: Three upper locks in 10 days but volume 20d is below its 120d average; watch only.

watch.subject: EPCL after +65.5% in three months
watch.trigger: Extended at 2% below its 252-day high; only revisit after a pullback and a read of the Q1 results.

not_known: FX reserves, current account, IMF status, the next MPC date and the political position are not in the bundle. Results for most names are not yet reported. No earnings-growth data (eps_yoy is blank for nearly all names).
contamination_note: No knowledge of events after 2022-04-22 was used. base_rates.csv carries a warning that it was measured partly after this date; I used it only as rough odds for type and took nothing from it about specific names. The conclusion to stay out comes from the bundle's own rate, rupee and inflation facts.
